rows.label: tlk45320121_05_msg0001
rows.name:
Now that our homeland is in an
unprecedented crisis, we need the
people of Gula to rise up!

rows.label: tlk45320121_05_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm thinking of visiting every house
and having everyone, young and old,
touch a Core Crystal!

rows.label: tlk45320121_05_msg0003
rows.name:
I suggested that to the Ministry of
Internal Affairs' Investigation
Bureau, but...

rows.label: tlk45320121_05_msg0004
rows.name:
But they told me no, on grounds that
we'd end up with a pile of citizens
lying in pools of their own blood.

rows.label: tlk45320121_05_msg0005
rows.name:
With Alst in this state, I
think everyone needs to
start doing something...
